title: Analyst lens: Sanofi vaccines in Taiwan

products.name: Beyfortus (nirsevimab)
products.signal: Posts this week discuss the cost of infant RSV antibodies: one doctor's post says societies recommend one dose for infants under 12 months at about NT$16,000 to 17,000 while NHI covers only high-risk premature infants, and a parent shares a hospital bill over NT$25,000 that included one RSV dose. Other posts ask about eligibility after age one and parents plan boosters.
products.implication: The discussion is about the self-pay (自費) market and out-of-pocket cost rather than the public programme, which this week's coverage does not show changing for RSV. Cost and eligibility questions are the main stakeholder pressure point.
products.action: Prepare an issue brief on cost-of-access and eligibility facts for infant RSV antibodies, verified against NHI rules, for use with paediatric societies and hospital departments; monitor how often cost posts recur.
who: NHI and Taiwan CDC policy staff
products.signal_zh: 本週貼文討論嬰兒RSV抗體的費用：一則醫師貼文指出，學會建議12個月以下嬰兒接種單劑，費用約NT$16,000至17,000，而健保僅給付高風險早產兒；一位家長分享一張超過NT$25,000、包含一劑RSV疫苗的醫院帳單。其他貼文詢問一歲以上的資格，且家長計畫施打加強劑。
products.implication_zh: 討論焦點在自費市場與自付費用，而非公費計畫；本週報導未顯示RSV公費計畫有所變動。費用與資格問題是主要的利害關係人壓力點。
products.action_zh: 請依健保規定核實，製作嬰兒RSV抗體取得費用與資格事實的議題簡報，供兒科學會及醫院科別使用；並監測費用相關貼文的重現頻率。
who_zh: 醫院新生兒科及兒科部門
健保署及疾管署政策人員

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine (Efluelda)
products.signal: Today's coverage has little specific to high-dose flu this week. The only mention is a media piece in which a health professional says flu can raise cardiovascular risk in older adults and advises assessing vaccination, referring to adjuvanted and high-dose options. Enhanced flu volume fell from 28 to 14 posts week on week.
products.implication: The public programme bought enhanced vaccines for people aged 65+ in long-term care first, so near-term attention is about eligibility and allocation. Self-pay availability for high-dose products is not visible in today's items.
products.action: Engage Taiwan CDC and long-term care facility contacts on allocation and eligibility questions; prepare evidence on the eligibility framework for enhanced flu vaccines without making comparative claims.
products.sub_zh: 增強型流感疫苗，高劑量，核准適用65歲以上
products.signal_zh: 今日報導中本週與高劑量流感疫苗相關的內容極少。唯一提及來自一則媒體報導，其中一位醫事人員表示流感可能增加長者心血管風險，並建議評估接種，其中提及佐劑型與高劑量選項。增強型流感疫苗聲量由上週28則降至14則。
products.implication_zh: 公費計畫優先為長照機構中65歲以上民眾購買增強型疫苗，因此近期關注焦點在資格與分配。今日項目中看不出高劑量產品的自費供應情形。
products.action_zh: 就分配與資格問題與疾管署及長照機構聯絡人接洽；準備增強型流感疫苗資格架構的證據，但不做比較性主張。

products.name: Tdap booster
products.signal: Today's coverage contains no Tdap-specific items in the last 72 hours. Tdap appears only in a storyline about medical societies urging vaccines for chronic lung disease, which has no items in the last seven days. Volume is 3 against 0 previously, which is too small to read as a trend.
products.implication: There is no clear public or self-pay signal for Tdap this week, so no immediate issue is visible.
products.action: No immediate action. Keep watch on whether medical society guidance on chronic lung disease mentions pertussis, and check for self-pay clinic reporting.
products.signal_zh: 今日報導在過去72小時內沒有Tdap相關項目。Tdap僅出現在醫學會呼籲為慢性肺病接種疫苗的報導脈絡中，而該脈絡在過去七天內沒有任何項目。聲量為3則，先前為0則，數量太少，不足以視為趨勢。
products.implication_zh: 本週沒有明顯的Tdap公費或自費訊號，目前看不到即時議題。
products.action_zh: 目前無需立即行動。請持續留意醫學會關於慢性肺病的指引是否提及百日咳，並查核自費診所的相關回報。

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.sub: Protein-based XFG-strain COVID-19 vaccine; distributed in Taiwan by Sanofi
products.signal: The Taiwan CDC said Novavax's protein-based vaccine was added to the public COVID-19 programme from October 19 under the joint campaign, with additional doses planned. Social posts about COVID-19 safety are general and not specific to any brand.
products.implication: Novavax is now a public programme option, so its uptake, allocation and local availability are the public-programme issues to track. General COVID-19 safety misinformation affects the category as a whole and may spill into questions about the product.
products.action: Engage Taiwan CDC and local health bureaus on availability and allocation questions; prepare a Novavax-specific fact sheet on programme eligibility and logistics; set up a rapid-response line for general safety questions.
who: local health bureaus and participating clinics
products.sub_zh: 以蛋白質為基礎的XFG株COVID-19疫苗；由賽諾菲在台灣經銷
products.signal_zh: 疾管署表示，Novavax以蛋白質為基礎的疫苗自10月19日起在聯合宣導下納入公費COVID-19計畫，並計畫增加劑量。社群貼文中關於COVID-19安全的內容屬一般性，並未針對任何品牌。
products.implication_zh: Novavax現已成為公費計畫選項，因此其接種率、分配與地方供應是需追蹤的公費計畫議題。一般性COVID-19安全錯誤資訊影響整個類別，並可能延伸至對該產品的疑問。
products.action_zh: 就供應與分配問題與疾管署及地方衛生局接洽；準備Novavax專屬的事實說明，涵蓋計畫資格與後勤；設置快速回應專線，處理一般安全問題。
who_zh: 地方衛生局及參與診所

issues.title: Second-stage public flu programme opens for remaining eligible groups
issues.note: The second stage of the 2026-27 public programme starts on this date, which may shift eligible-group questions and enhanced flu allocation discussions.
issues.title_zh: 第二階段公費流感計畫開放其餘符合資格的族群
issues.note_zh: 2026-27年度公費計畫第二階段於此日開始，可能改變合格族群的相關問題及增強型流感疫苗的分配討論。

issues.title: Infant RSV antibody cost debate escalates in parent and clinical forums
issues.note: Cost and eligibility posts are rising and concern the self-pay market; a clear, sourced explainer on coverage would help clinics and parents.
issues.title_zh: 嬰兒RSV抗體費用爭論在家長及臨床論壇中升溫
issues.note_zh: 費用與資格相關貼文持續增加，且涉及自費市場；清楚且有來源的保險範圍說明，將有助於診所與家長。

issues.title: Flu supply and quadrivalent availability claims reach clinics and the public
issues.note: Posts claim flu stock is low and media are addressing quadrivalent disappearance rumours; unverified, so monitor clinic stock reports.
issues.title_zh: 流感供應及四價疫苗供應說法已觸及診所與民眾
issues.note_zh: 貼文稱流感庫存偏低，媒體正回應四價疫苗絕跡的傳言；此說法未經證實，請監測診所庫存回報。

self_pay.title: Infant RSV antibody out-of-pocket cost is the main self-pay discussion
self_pay.note: A doctor's post cites societies recommending one dose for infants under 12 months at about NT$16,000 to 17,000 while NHI covers only high-risk premature infants, and a parent's bill over NT$25,000 included one RSV dose. These are posts and anecdotes rather than verified price data.
self_pay.title_zh: 嬰兒RSV抗體的自付費用是主要的自費討論議題
self_pay.note_zh: 一位醫師的貼文引述學會建議12個月以下嬰兒接種單劑，費用約NT$16,000至17,000，而健保僅給付高風險早產兒；一位家長超過NT$25,000的帳單包含一劑RSV疫苗。這些屬於貼文與個案分享，而非經證實的價格數據。

self_pay.title: Flu stock and quadrivalent availability questions in the self-pay channel
self_pay.note: Media explainers address claims that quadrivalent flu vaccines have disappeared, and posts claim flu stock is below half. The items do not confirm clinic-level stock or prices, and no enhanced (adjuvanted or high-dose) self-pay availability is reported.
self_pay.title_zh: 自費管道中的流感庫存及四價疫苗供應問題
self_pay.note_zh: 媒體解說回應四價流感疫苗已絕跡的說法，貼文稱流感庫存低於一半。內容未能證實診所層級的庫存或價格，亦未報導增強型（佐劑型或高劑量）流感疫苗的自費供應情形。

self_pay.title: Little signal on self-pay for enhanced flu, Tdap and other products
self_pay.note: Today's items say little about self-pay pricing or clinic promotion for enhanced flu vaccines or Tdap, and demand from people outside eligible groups is not clearly visible. The only self-pay mention is a local outbreak report that refers to self-paid vaccination without detail.
self_pay.title_zh: 增強型流感、Tdap及其他產品的自費訊號很少
self_pay.note_zh: 今日項目對增強型流感疫苗或Tdap的自費定價或診所促銷所述甚少，符合資格族群以外的需求也未明顯可見。唯一提及自費的是一則地方疫情報導，僅提到自費接種而未說明細節。
